visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged Asian man with short dark hair, wearing a grey t-shirt and a black smartwatch, stands against a white brick wall background. He smiles broadly and gestures with his hands towards the camera. On-screen graphics show a magnifying glass with the text '新品特搜隊 123'. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of three packaged desserts on a green polka-dot tablecloth. A green circular logo for FamilyMart appears. The man holds a yellow and white package of 'Vanilla Custard Donut' and opens it, revealing a round, sugar-dusted donut. (3) The man takes a bite of the donut, squinting his eyes with a satisfied expression. Floating heart stickers appear around his head. He pulls the donut apart to show the creamy white custard filling inside, which looks moist and fluffy. (4) The scene shifts to the man holding a second package, 'Creme Brulee Cake'. He removes the clear plastic cover to reveal a round sponge cake topped with a dark caramelized layer. A cross-section shot shows a thick yellow custard layer in the middle containing crushed nut pieces. (5) He holds the third item, a 'Pistachio Mille-Feuille' in a black plastic tray. The cake has many thin green layers topped with a light green cream and crushed pistachio nuts. He uses a small wooden fork to cut into it, demonstrating its soft and creamy texture. (6) The man returns to the eye-level shot in front of the brick wall, continuing to speak enthusiastically to the camera while holding the desserts. Various colorful variety-show style captions pop up around him as he concludes his review.
